benchmark.decision: GO TO REVIEW only if all numerical/validation tests pass, all5aggregate paired wall savings positive at both micro/macro, median speedup>=1.02 both, no case median slowdown>2%, no unexplained allocation growth. Otherwise NO BENEFIT or NO-GO/UNRESOLVED.

benchmark.arithmetic: Exact RHS and all saved r/v/q/S bytes required; any unexplained delta -> NO-GO, preserve values; SO3 independent observer if unequal. No thresholds changed.
